account_rules_lock_level_check.name: account_rules_lock_level_check
account_rules_lock_level_check.value: lock_level is null or (drawdown_type = 'eod_trailing' and lock_level > 0)

account_rules_amounts_check.name: account_rules_amounts_check
account_rules_amounts_check.value: profit_target > 0 and drawdown_amount > 0 and (daily_loss_limit is null or daily_loss_limit > 0)

account_rules_consistency_check.name: account_rules_consistency_check
account_rules_consistency_check.value: consistency_percent is null or consistency_percent between 1 and 100

ledger_entries_category_check.name: ledger_entries_category_check
ledger_entries_category_check.value: (kind = 'expense' and category in ('evaluation', 'reset', 'activation', 'subscription', 'data', 'other')) or (kind <> 'expense' and category is null)

trade_accounts_commission_check.name: trade_accounts_commission_check
trade_accounts_commission_check.value: (commission is null and commission_source is null) or (commission >= 0 and commission_source in ('file', 'rate', 'manual'))
